game_concept: A programming puzzle set in Mt. Pyre – Geyser Flats, erupting geyser flats: the lava scout must handle fire sprites while practicing data types & operators. Core idea – Compound Combo: Chain +=, -=, *= updates to hit a target value exactly.
theme: Mt. Pyre – Geyser Flats: erupting geyser flats
core_gameplay_loop: In Geyser Flats, repeat each round: Chain +=, -=, *= updates to hit a target value exactly. Each round costs one action, so plan the step so none are wasted. Then check the energy value and advance.
player_objective: Reach the forge anvil using at most 18 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
win_condition: The forge anvil reached with actions_used <= 18.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 18 before the forge anvil is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 2 – Data Types & Operators | Level 8 (extended tier): Compound Combo
assets_style: pixel-art volcano: purple-black rock, glowing lava rivers, orange ember light, drifting ash; flat Kenney-style sprites; low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Compound Combo' (Week 2 slot 12), mission type 'Efficiency Trial', and setting 'Geyser Flats'. tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how energy changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against fire sprites in Geyser Flats.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: The forge anvil reached with actions_used <= 18.
